# /etc/systemd/system/formation-agent@.service
[Unit]
Description=Distributed CZ225 MentorPi formation agent for %i
After=network-online.target docker.service mentorpi-localization.service
Wants=network-online.target docker.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=root
EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/openvela-formation
ExecStart=/opt/openvela-formation/scripts/run_formation_agent.sh %i
KillSignal=SIGINT
TimeoutStopSec=8
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target


# /etc/systemd/system/formation-command-bridge@.service
No files found for formation-reconfiguration.service.
[Unit]
Description=Locked formation command bridge for %i
Requires=docker.service start_node.service
After=docker.service start_node.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=pi
ExecStart=/opt/openvela-formation/scripts/run_command_bridge.sh %i
ExecStopPost=/opt/openvela-formation/scripts/stop_command_bridge.sh %i
Restart=always
RestartSec=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
